https://status.fountain.coach/.well-known/agent-bootstrap.json

Human projection:
https://status.fountain.coach/for-agents/

Strategic business architecture:
https://status.fountain.coach/business-architecture.json

Human projection:
https://status.fountain.coach/business-architecture/

The business architecture distinguishes capabilities, assets, products, markets, business-model portfolio, Wardley strategy, evidence, risks, and hypotheses. Read state labels before treating a proposal as an existing or commercial fact. The public projection does not replace private runtime authority or MIDI Association normative authority.

Language rule:
The status estate is English-only. German projections and the language switch are offline; the canonical human routes are the English routes at https://status.fountain.coach/.

Read the JSON router first. If it is unavailable, do not treat the human projection as machine authority; apply bootstrap-unreachable and STOP.
